name: Yellow Legacy Changes
description: Yellow Legacy by TSP changes: buffed/nerfed moves, rebalanced stats, trade evolutions become level evolutions, rebalanced trainer and gym-leader teams (rival Eevee replaced by the starter lines: Bulbasaur for Jolteon, Charmander for Flareon, Squirtle for Vaporeon), Ghost special + super-effective vs Psychic, and a MODS-menu toggle for Dragon physical.
